newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Clorox is a Salomon top pick.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Clorox is a Salomon top pick.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Carol Warner said Clorox Co is a "top pick" for 1997.
-- said estimates second-quarter operating income growth of 12 percent, with a 14 percent increase in earnings to $0.83 per share from $0.73 per share last year.
-- said she was expecting a solid second quarter from Clorox, with sales growth to be up by about nine percent to $509.5 million, a much larger increase than some of its rivals.
-- Clorox shares were up two at 102-1/8 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
